svg.aria-label: Down the stack, from high level into the machine, shown as a photograph of a silicon chip under a microscope. HTML and CSS: learning. Python: solid. Java: learning. C: curious. Assembly: curious. A small pulse travels from Python down the line into the chip. Next: security, across every layer, and AI systems that keep working when an API fails.
